reviews.conclusion: The run is left during the bracket: saving world, a different overworld instance, clearing SeedQueue, title screen, world list and loading are directly visible before the original nether run resumes. This is a world/client workflow interruption rather than an isolated unexplained timer deficit. These screens do not all imply identical GUI-tick behavior, so their durations are not summed to assert exact equality with -5.55 s.

Terrain loading, a long pause-menu visit and two shorter menu visits are visible; menu-only duration bounds total approximately 3.5-5.0 s. An additional approximately 2.75-3.25 s has an obscured/narrow game window. Ordinary non-gameplay behavior can explain a deficit, but the -5.5 s value cannot be equated exactly from this proxy.
An End transition is followed by approximately 1.0-1.5 s of options/video-settings menus, compatible with -1.3 s.
One single-sample pause visit and a three-sample settings visit total approximately 0.5-1.5 s, compatible with -1.1667 s. Narrow-window phases are also visible; their pause state is unknown.
Two two-sample options visits total approximately 0.5-1.5 s, compatible with -1.1 s. The rest of the clip shows bastion looting, combat and inventory use.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
